Onboarding.Step1Body: RemindMe helps you never forget what matters: create recurring reminders with your own icon, sound and description, and stay organized effortlessly.
Onboarding.Step2Body: Press **+** in the top left to add one: choose a name, description (also in **Markdown**), an icon and a notification sound, and decide whether it should always stay on top.
Onboarding.Step3Body: The **execution method** decides the behavior: on PC startup every so often, within a custom time range, or once a day at a specific time. Set the repeat interval with the dedicated button.
Onboarding.Step4Body: Use the search bar to filter reminders. Right-click a row to quickly edit, duplicate, delete, rename or enable/disable a reminder.
Onboarding.Step5Body: Export the list as **CSV** or **PDF** from the toolbar, or the whole list as JSON from the **File** menu. In **Options > Preferences** you can change the language and switch between light and dark theme at any time.
